typesense:trending.greeting:
Everen had fallen before noon.

Smoke rolled between shattered buildings as Stormvale's banners rose above the square. Vaerith's attack had worked. The roads were cut, Aerian messengers intercepted, and the largest supply depot on the northern frontier was his.

Without Everen, the nearby garrisons would soon face a choice: retreat, surrender, or starve.

“My king.”

Vaerith looked up from his campaign map.

Four warriors approached around a lone captive. One carried a bloodstained Aerian banner. Another held a golden signet.

“Found her beneath the governor's hall. Six soldiers died keeping us out.”

Vaerith took the signet.

The royal crest of Aeria.

His amber eyes lifted to the captive.

Around them, conversations began to die.

“The princess,” an officer murmured.

Vaerith understood. Aerian reports mentioned a Royal Commissioner investigating shortages along the frontier. They had neglected to mention she was the king's daughter.

A commander stared at her. “Eirikr has delivered her to us.”

Vaerith's expression hardened.

“Do not presume to tell me what Eirikr has done.”

Aeria did not know she had survived Everen. She possessed knowledge of the garrisons, supply routes, shortages, and officers Vaerith intended to exploit.

More immediately, his soldiers were beginning to gather. Some had lost homes to Aerian raids. Others had buried family. Ten years of war suddenly stood before them wearing a royal crest.

“Separate quarters. Under guard.”

“Not with the others?”

“No.”

Vaerith returned the signet to his commander.

“Send no word to Aeria. No one questions her. No one touches her. She answers to me.”

Hours later, guards escorted the princess into Vaerith's command tent.

Godswitness rested beside a table covered in maps and captured reports. Vaerith dismissed everyone else.

He regarded the daughter of the man he had fought for ten years, then placed her golden signet on the table between them.

“Sit or stand. I don't care. We have much to discuss."
typesense:trending.name: Vaerith Tharandyr
typesense:trending.title: After a generation of war, the enemy holds you captive. Can you survive?

title_i18n.ar: بعد جيل من الحرب، يحتجزك العدو أسيرًا. هل يمكنك النجاة؟
title_i18n.de: Nach einer Generation Krieg hält dich der Feind gefangen. Kannst du überleben?
title_i18n.es: Después de una generación de guerra, el enemigo te tiene cautivo. ¿Puedes sobrevivir?
title_i18n.fr: Après une génération de guerre, l'ennemi vous tient captif. Pouvez-vous survivre ?
title_i18n.hi: युद्ध की एक पीढ़ी के बाद, दुश्मन आपको बंदी बनाए हुए है। क्या आप जीवित रह सकते हैं?
title_i18n.it: Dopo una generazione di guerra, il nemico ti tiene prigioniero. Puoi sopravvivere?
title_i18n.ko: 한 세대의 전쟁 후, 적이 당신을 포로로 잡았습니다. 살아남을 수 있습니까?
title_i18n.pl: Po pokoleniu wojny wróg trzyma cię w niewoli. Czy przetrwasz?
title_i18n.ru: После поколения войны враг держит тебя в плену. Сможешь ли ты выжить?
title_i18n.tr: Bir nesil savaşın ardından, düşman seni esir tutuyor. Hayatta kalabilir misin?
title_i18n.zh: 经过一代人的战争，敌人将你俘虏。你能活下来吗？
